name: Pig-Faced Orc (Orc Variant)
body:
This variety of orc has a reputation for being particularly brutish, boorish, and savage. They have boar-like snouts, large tusks, and small, beady eyes. Pig-faced orcs are chaotic and bloodthirsty in the extreme, and will war with anyone. They are especially fond of fighting goblins, dwarves, elves—and most of all other orcs.

Ability Score Modifiers You gain +2 Str, +2 Con, –2 Int, –2 Cha. This trait alters ability scores.
Piggish You have the scent universal monster ability, and you gain a +2 species bonus against effects that cause the nauseated or sickened conditions. This trait replaces ferocity.
Alternate Species Trait

Battle Tusks You have exceptionally large tusks, which you have learned how to sharpen and use to make deadly attacks. You gain a gore attack; this is a primary natural attack hat deals 1d6 piercing damage. This trait replaces weapon familiarity.

Awesome Ancestries: Variant Species Options, Vol. 2 – Mortals of the Multiverse. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum
